Meeting: Orbit Financial Planning Steering Committee
Participants: Maya Kim, Rhea Bell, Rhea Ortiz, Omar White, Farah Liu, Ishaan Nair, Meera Iyer, Gabriel Chen

00:03 Maya Kim: We need to resolve forecast cadence because it affects the next milestone.
00:09 Rhea Bell: Main risk is template incompatibility; current status report understates it.
00:16 Rhea Ortiz: The older option still works technically but increases operating complexity.
00:24 Omar White: Client/business preference is to protect the core outcome even if we resequence scope.
00:31 Farah Liu: Cross-project dependency on PULSE is shared platform compute and batch windows.
00:38 Ishaan Nair: Proposed decision: Monthly rolling forecast replaces quarterly-only planning.
00:44 Maya Kim: Agreed. Mark the prior assumption as superseded, not deleted.
00:49 Rhea Bell: BA will update requirements; QA will update acceptance coverage.
00:55 Rhea Ortiz: Keep the rejected approach in the ADR because future teams will ask why we did not use it.
